# Crolyo

> Crolyo is a lightweight live chat widget for websites that routes visitor messages into Slack. Teams reply from a Slack thread (desktop or mobile) and the reply is delivered back to the visitor in real time. Built for indie hackers and early-stage founders who want fast support and sales conversations without a helpdesk.

Key facts:

- Setup: add one script tag before the closing `</body>` tag, then connect a Slack channel to the site. Takes about 2 minutes.
- Widget payload is under 100KB, so it won't hurt Lighthouse scores.
- Works on any website, with native Next.js support.
- Pricing: 14-day free trial (no card required), then $8/month or $80/year (2 months free). Payments are processed by Dodo Payments as Merchant of Record.
- Cancel anytime; access continues until the end of the paid period. Payments are non-refundable except for billing errors or where required by law.
